description: Every asset a modern website could ever need. Filled entries are what VF actively uses. Empty slots stay as capabilities. Add anything to any category via the Assets panel with Claude, or edit here directly.

logo.usage: Primary VF wordmark and favicon; nav bar mark.

logo-dark.usage: Mark for dark backgrounds (error / night surfaces).

wordmark.slot: Full VF Empire wordmark for large surfaces.

monogram.slot: Tight VF monogram for square avatars.

logo-lockup-tagline.slot: Logo + tagline lockup for hero banners.

logo-monochrome-white.slot: Single-colour white variant for dark backgrounds.

vf-mail-inbox.slot: VF Mail inbox screenshot for /systems/vf-mail hero.

icons.note: Line-icon library for feature grids, buttons, chips. 1.4px stroke, 20–24px. Add named entries here as you need them.

empty-inbox.slot: Empty-state illustration for VF Mail inbox.

core-fade.usage: Reserved for primary CTA hover treatments.

sunrise.slot: Warm accent gradient for special campaigns.

silver-fade.slot: Subtle silver gradient for section backgrounds.

hdri.slot: HDRI environment map for realistic renders.

invoice.slot: Invoice email template (Noirda GmbH invoicing arm).

safari-pinned-tab.slot: Monochrome SVG for Safari pinned tab.

muted-text.slot: Deeper muted text between dove and ink.

spacing-scale.note: Named scale steps for consistent rhythm across the site.

gradient-band.slot: Named gradient border for hero bands.

up.keyframes: @keyframes up { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(26px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

rv.css: opacity: 0; transform: translateY(34px); transition: opacity .9s var(--ease), transform .9s var(--ease); &.on { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

bt-loading.slot: Button in loading state with spinner.

product-card.slot: Reusable product card for slate grids.

hero-carousel.slot: Carousel hero for multi-message launch pages.

logo-cloud.slot: 'As seen in / trusted by' logo strip.

brand-display.slot: Optional bold display face for special launches.

notes.editing: Every entry above is either a live asset or an empty capability slot. Fill any empty slot when you need it by clicking it in the Assets panel and asking Claude to build it, or edit here directly. Colour changes should mirror to /house.css :root; radius/spacing changes should be inherited via CSS variables.
notes.adding: To create a new category or entry not listed here, either add it directly in this file or use POST /api/assets from the editor. Empty slots signal capability, not usage — VF isn't wasting effort filling every box, only what a live page needs.
notes.philosophy: The kit is exhaustive on capability, minimal on ceremony. Every choice on the site should be traceable back to a kit entry; every kit entry should have a real reason to exist.
